meta.source: Mapillary street-level imagery (CC BY-SA 4.0), Mapillary contributors; tools/world/mapillary/s3_facades.py
meta.ids: 'tx_tz:i' = tile + index in its BUILDINGS section, cx / cz = footprint centroid (OrthoRoofs.Get key + check)
meta.rgb: linear sRGB 0..1 facade albedo estimate: chromaticity measured (white balance from the road asphalt in the same photo), lightness = rank of the measured (sun-angle corrected) luminance mapped to L* 58..92; srgb = the same as sRGB hex
meta.conf: 0..1; below ~0.3 treat as a guess (one image, little wall visible, inconsistent views)
